text: {"lessons":["Selling winning shares repeatedly felt reassuring, but gains versus my purchase price do not predict what comes next; I should base trades on a consistent plan, not the feeling of locking in a win.","I should judge the whole portfolio, including cash and risk, rather than treating each stock as a separate account or letting reluctance to admit a mistake keep me invested.","The account’s value can fall even after several profitable sales; with unpredictable prices, I should diversify and avoid assuming recent moves will continue."]}
